BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the reorganization of natural resource agencieswith the goal of improving services and efficiency; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state of Washington, from one corner tothe other, is blessed with magnificent natural resources in all partsof the state, comprised of fish and wildlife, water, forest andagriculture lands, and parks and outdoor recreational lands. Just asthere is an abundance of natural resources, there is also a complexadministrative system of several state agencies that manage, preserve,and protect those resources. It is the intent of the legislature to consolidate, streamline, andreorganize the agencies responsible for administering the naturalresources of Washington with the goal of improving management of theresources and providing better services to citizens in the mostefficient and costeffective manner while continuing to meet the needsof present and future generations. Washington's citizens and economy p. 1 HB 1460are dependent on natural resources and an efficient system to managethose natural resources.
